note: A small stand in for src/shared/drill-library.json, in its own shape (one cause a drill, the cause as death-causes.js or insights.js names it without its cause: prefix, or general; bands as rank-band.js keys, empty for every band; where, minutes, steps, goal, why and check), so test:practice holds its rules on drills that never change under it.

drills.title: Fight where a teammate can trade
steps: Queue Team Deathmatch and pick one teammate to stay near for the whole game.
Before every fight, check that your teammate can see the same angle.
If they cannot, step back and wait for them instead of swinging.
After each death, say out loud whether you could have been traded.
drills.goal: Ten fights in a row taken with a teammate in view of your angle.
drills.why: A short why for fight where a teammate can trade.
drills.check: Your next review counts fewer deaths nobody traded.

drills.title: Swing second, then trade
steps: Start a custom game with a friend, or Team Deathmatch with a duo.
Let your partner take the first look at a corner while you hold half a step behind.
The moment they are shot at, swing the same angle and trade.
Swap roles every five fights.
drills.goal: Trade your partner within two seconds in 7 of 10 tries.
drills.why: A short why for swing second, then trade.
drills.check: Your next review shows more traded deaths and fewer first deaths left alone.

drills.title: Clear one angle at a time
steps: In the Practice Range, set the bots on the left to strafe.
Walk the course and stop at each corner before you look past it.
Clear one angle, then the next, never two at once.
Count the angles you rushed and try to get the count to zero.
drills.goal: Three runs of the course with no angle rushed.
drills.why: A short why for clear one angle at a time.
drills.check: Your next review counts fewer deaths in the first 30 seconds of a round.

drills.title: Jiggle for information, then peek
steps: Set the Range bots to peek a doorway at random.
Jiggle peek the doorway first, a short look in and out.
Only take the full peek after the jiggle showed you where the bot is.
After a fight, move off the angle before you look again.
drills.goal: Twenty peeks, each one after a jiggle, none from the same spot twice.
drills.why: A short why for jiggle for information, then peek.
drills.check: Your next review counts fewer dry peeks and repeeks.

drills.title: Play one step off the usual spot
steps: Load your most played map in a custom game.
Walk to the spot you die at most and find two other spots that hold the same angle.
For each one, check you can step back behind cover after a kill.
Pick a different one of the three each round of your next match.
drills.goal: Three spots for each site you defend, each with a way out.
drills.why: A short why for play one step off the usual spot.
drills.check: Your next review shows your deaths spread across more places.

drills.title: When you are up, group and hold
steps: In Team Deathmatch, after every kill your team gets, stop and hold your angle for three seconds.
Let the enemy come to you instead of chasing the next fight.
Only push once a teammate is beside you.
drills.goal: A whole game where you never chase straight after a kill.
drills.why: A short why for when you are up, group and hold.
drills.check: Your next review counts fewer rounds where you gave back the advantage.

drills.title: Crosshair at head height
steps: In the Practice Range, walk the strafing bots course.
Keep your crosshair at head height on every corner before a bot appears.
Move only your feet to clear angles, not your aim up and down.
Finish with fifty shots at the bots on medium.
drills.goal: Most of your first shots land at head height without moving your aim up.
drills.why: A short why for crosshair at head height.
drills.check: Your next review shows more duels won from a sound position.

drills.title: One Deathmatch, one focus
steps: Before your first match of the day, play one Deathmatch.
Pick one thing to work on for the whole game, such as stopping before you shoot.
Ignore your score and count how often you did that one thing.
drills.goal: One whole Deathmatch keeping to the one thing you picked.
drills.why: A short why for one deathmatch, one focus.
drills.check: Your first match after it starts calmer, and the review shows it.

drills.title: Learn one setup for your agent
steps: Load a custom game on the map you play next.
Learn one setup with your agent's utility that covers a plant or a defuse.
Throw it five times from the same spot until it lands the same way.
Use it once in your next match.
drills.goal: One setup you can throw the same way five times in a row.
drills.why: A short why for learn one setup for your agent.
drills.check: Your next review counts fewer deaths in the open on the spike.
